notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 11
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.444 has just gone live! Changes: 

Added new item, Scepter of Shift (moves the crown to a new location),

Added new item, Half Roller (reduces maximum roll for your next turn to 5),

Added item rarity system to make some items appear more often vs others,

Fixes: 

Fix "Get Crown" sound sometimes playing twice on client

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 10
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.439 has just gone live!

Changes:

- Limit number of saves to 10

- Sort save files by last time the file has been modified

- Delete games save file after game is over

Fixes:

- Fixed lobby slot not being usable if player leaves during character selection

- Fixed being able to take over other players characters in the character select screen if a client leaves and rejoins

- Fixed "toggle ready" sound effect playing if a player leaves after the game started

- Fixed "Last Turn" text displaying wrong text

- Fixed save file not working sometimes if map has been changed

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 9
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.438 has just gone live! Changes: 

Updated item card colors and their meanings

Orange = Negative effect,

Lime = Neutral effect,

Cyan = Positive effect,

Purple = Rare Special item,

Minigame Cubic Crisis Climb can now end in a draw

Fixes: 

Player rotation between rounds of minigame Seaside Scavengers now properly resets

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 8
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.436 has just gone live!

Changes:

- improved minigame character collision

Fixes:

- Fixed some instances where bots could get stuck after taking over a player

- Fixed issue that would break minigames in multiplayer under certain conditions

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 7
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.433 has just gone live! Changes: 

Change Item placement to allow for placing items 5 places ahead and backwards, instead of just forwards,

Added another free item space to Beachy Beach,

Made the shop cost and use cost of all items cheaper to make them more viable,

Improve physics on grenades in minigame FragBallFury,

Fixes: 

Fixed coins on minigame Lawn loot rumble snapping position,

Fixed misaligned grenades on minigame FragBallFury

Special thanks to discord member Kunai Kazekun for providing critical feedback for this update!

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 6
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.432 has just gone live! 

Changes: 

Add loading status to players when loading into main game and minigame,

Made screen fully fade out before the loading of main game starts,

Fixes 

Fixed non-host players not being able to switch between keyboard and controller after game starts,

Fix inconsistencies and rare crashes when joining the game late,

Fix main game mode music playing during minigame when joining after a minigame started

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 5

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game Playtest Patch 4
notes.notes:
Playtest version 0.1.0.428 has just gone live!

Changes: 

Added player auto timeout. In multiplayer, if a player is inactive for 30 seconds on their turn, a Bot will take over for them,

 Fixes:

Fix another network error logged when starting game

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game playtest patch 3
